data.narrative:
The ePlane Company is a Series B autonomous aviation venture operating in the Drones & Autonomous sector, which comprises eight private peers and no public comparables. The company has raised $14M+ to date and is actively fundraising for $40–50M in the current round.

Valuation analysis is constrained by the composition of available comparables. The Peer-Median method proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers meeting filtering thresholds; the broader sector contains only one same-stage data point and zero adjacent-stage equivalents. The Stage-Progression method was therefore the sole applicable triangulation approach, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier from the $14M raised proxy to derive an implied valuation of $27M. This multiplier reflects typical Series B-to-next-stage progression observed across venture financings.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $31M, centered on $27M. This range incorporates a ±15% sensitivity band around the stage-progression median. Key uncertainties limiting confidence include the narrow peer comparability set—no public market anchors and limited private-market same-stage transactions in autonomous aviation—and the reliance on a single valuation method. Investor diligence should prioritize unit economics, technical validation milestones, and regulatory pathway clarity, as these will materially inform Series B follow-on rounds.
